US_presidential.title: Primary Season Begins
US_presidential.description: State primaries and caucuses begin to select each party's presidential nominee.

US_presidential.title: National Conventions
US_presidential.description: Each major party holds a convention to formally nominate their presidential and vice-presidential candidates.

US_presidential.title: General Election Campaign
US_presidential.description: Nominated candidates campaign nationwide with debates, rallies, and advertising.

US_presidential.title: Voter Registration Deadline
US_presidential.description: Most states require registration 15-30 days before Election Day. Some allow same-day registration.

US_presidential.title: Early Voting Period
US_presidential.description: Many states allow in-person early voting 1-2 weeks before Election Day.

US_presidential.title: Election Day
US_presidential.description: The first Tuesday after the first Monday in November. Polls typically open 6-7 AM and close 7-8 PM.
US_presidential.dateRange: First Tuesday after first Monday in November

US_presidential.title: Vote Counting
US_presidential.description: Ballots are counted. Some states report quickly; mail-in ballots may take days to process.

US_presidential.title: Electoral College Vote
US_presidential.description: Electors meet in state capitals to cast their electoral votes for president.

US_presidential.title: Congressional Certification
US_presidential.description: Congress meets in joint session to count and certify electoral votes.

US_presidential.title: Inauguration Day
US_presidential.description: The new president is sworn into office on the steps of the U.S. Capitol.

UK_general.title: Parliament Dissolved
UK_general.description: Parliament is dissolved, triggering the official election period of approximately 5 weeks.

UK_general.title: Candidate Nominations Close
UK_general.description: Candidates must submit nomination papers with required deposits and signatures.

UK_general.title: Voter Registration Deadline
UK_general.description: Last day to register to vote at gov.uk/register-to-vote.

UK_general.title: Campaign Period
UK_general.description: Parties campaign across constituencies. Leaders participate in televised debates.

UK_general.title: Polling Day
UK_general.description: Voters cast ballots at local polling stations from 7 AM to 10 PM.

UK_general.title: Overnight Count
UK_general.description: Votes are counted overnight with results declared constituency by constituency.
UK_general.dateRange: Polling Day night into early morning

UK_general.title: Government Formation
UK_general.description: The party or coalition with a majority is invited by the Monarch to form a government.

IN_general.title: Election Schedule Announced
IN_general.description: The Election Commission of India announces dates for the multi-phase general election.

IN_general.title: Nomination Period
IN_general.description: Candidates file nominations in their respective constituencies with required deposits.

IN_general.title: Campaign Period
IN_general.description: Intensive campaigning with rallies, door-to-door canvassing, and media blitzes.

IN_general.title: Multi-Phase Voting
IN_general.description: Voting occurs in 5-7 phases across different states to allow security forces to be deployed.

IN_general.title: Counting Day
IN_general.description: All votes across all phases are counted simultaneously on a single day.

IN_general.title: Results Declaration
IN_general.description: The Election Commission declares results and the winning party/coalition is invited to form government.
